name: Bone Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Poison damage taken.

description: Bone devils are skeletal, scorpion-tailed torturers who serve as interrogators and taskmasters in the Nine Hells, delighting in the slow, wasting agony of their poisoned sting.
